description: Restores a previously deleted ticket in Zendesk. Use when a ticket was accidentally deleted and needs to be recovered. The restored ticket will return to its previous state with all associated data intact. This action is reversible — tickets can be deleted again after restoration if needed.

ticket_id.description: ID of the deleted ticket to restore.
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk ticket that was previously deleted and needs to be restored. You can find this ID from ticket deletion logs or trash.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id

name: restore_zendesk_ticket

assignee_id.description: The ID of the agent assigned to the ticket
assignee_id.title: Assignee Id

created_at.description: When the ticket was created (ISO 8601 format)
created_at.title: Created At

group_id.description: The ID of the group assigned to the ticket
group_id.title: Group Id

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization of the requester
organization_id.title: Organization Id

priority.description: The urgency level of the ticket (urgent, high, normal, low)
priority.title: Priority

requester_id.description: The ID of the user who requested support
requester_id.title: Requester Id

status.description: The state of the ticket (new, open, pending, hold, solved, closed)
status.title: Status

subject.description: The subject/title of the restored ticket
subject.title: Subject

submitter_id.description: The ID of the user who submitted the ticket
submitter_id.title: Submitter Id

success.description: Indicates whether the ticket restoration was successful
success.title: Success

ticket_type.description: The type of the ticket (problem, incident, question, task)
ticket_type.title: Ticket Type

updated_at.description: When the ticket was last updated (ISO 8601 format)
updated_at.title: Updated At
